svg.title: Dual-porosity soil model
svg.desc: Two cell types: matrix cells hold water and carbon, macropore cells host microbes; the matrix slowly feeds the macropores. Three soils differ in their mix.
svg.text: Dual porosity: each cell is one of two things
holds water + carbon · microbes can't live here
fast flow · microbes live + respire here
The three soils differ only in the mix
